proof.claim: 100 legal fixed-60-Hz control traces win after satisfying the weapon-specific technique, any explicit defense objective, and a physical KO. games.uiWitnessMapping: Analog joystick/keyboard and J/K/L/Space (P2 arrows/N/M/comma/period).
